intent: audit-surface Phase 2 Commit J: Q2 + Q4 + Q5 new audit-question surfaces
notes: Second code delivery of the 2026-08-14 Enterprise audit surface implementation plan (r10). Phase 2 Commit J of 3 — the three new Phase-1-artifact DATA-BUT-NO-SURFACE surfaces (Q2, Q4, Q5) implemented per the R3/R4/R5 ratifications from Phase 1 exit. All classifications flip to EXISTS for Claude/Codex post-commit; Q5's Gemini cross-bucket answer-completeness caveat (Migration 011 dependency) stays as documented in Q5's Notes column per r10 bucket discipline.

**Q4 — `commits provenance <sha>`** (R3 = (i) dedicated verb). New file `enterprise/app/routes/commits.py` with `GET /api/v1/commits/{sha}/provenance?repo_canonical_id=<id>` returning commit-side provenance (commit_sha, repo_identifier, author_identity, committed_at, machine_id, machine_label, snippet_agent, transcript_session_id) populated during commit reconciliation from Migration 008's snippet fields. Multi-match returns all candidates in `commits` array; CLI (`_handle_provenance`) prints a compact ambiguity table + `--repo` disambiguation hint when >1 match, prints full key/value detail when 1 match. 7-40-char SHA prefix matching mirrors `/commits/{sha}/transcripts`.

**Q2 — `commits list --repo <id>`** (R4 = (a) flag-style repo scoping). `enterprise/app/routes/repos.py::list_repo_commits` with `GET /api/v1/repos/{repo_canonical_id:path}/commits?limit=&offset=` returning per-commit rows shaped like Migration 010's `commits_with_transcript_coverage` view. Route-level composition of the view's join (rather than direct `SELECT ... FROM commits_with_transcript_coverage`) so SQLite in-memory tests work without recreating the view at `Base.metadata.create_all` time. New module-level `_LINKAGE_BASIS_RANK` constant kept in sync with Migration 010's CASE ordering. Python-side grouping keeps SQL portable across Postgres/SQLite.

**Q5 — `repos transcripts <id>`** (R5 = (b) symmetric verb). `enterprise/app/routes/repos.py::list_repo_transcripts` with `GET /api/v1/repos/{repo_canonical_id:path}/transcripts?vendor=&since=&limit=&offset=` doing the 3-way join `TranscriptSession ⨝ CommitTranscriptLink ⨝ Commit WHERE Commit.repo_identifier = ?` with `DISTINCT` on TranscriptSession (dedupes when one session links N commits in same repo). Ordered by `started_at DESC`. CLI in `commands/repos.py::_handle_transcripts` prints a table with Transcript/Vendor/Model/SessionID/Started/Machine/Bytes columns.

**Path-converter fix — mid-development finding.** FastAPI treats `/` in path params as separators by default, so `/repos/local/x/commits` would match `repo_canonical_id=local` and 404 on the tail. Discovered via 9 initial test failures; both `/repos/*` routes now use `{repo_canonical_id:path}` converter to allow slashes in canonical ids (which follow `local/<name>` shape on this machine per inbox machine-state). Full test sweep post-fix: all 16 new tests green.

**New router wired** at `enterprise/app/main.py` — `commits_router` from the new `routes/commits.py`, registered with `/api/v1` prefix + auth deps. Follows the established router-registration pattern (10th router). CLI `commits` subcommand group extended from 1 subcommand (`transcripts`) → 3 (`transcripts`, `list`, `provenance`). CLI `repos` subcommand group extended from 3 (`list`, `refresh`, `policies`) → 4 (adds `transcripts`).
`TestCommitProvenance` (7): full-SHA return, prefix return, ambiguous-prefix multi-match, `repo_canonical_id` narrowing, empty-for-no-match, short-prefix-rejected-400, nulls-when-snippet-absent.
